name: Duck Head
why: The 1865 Nashville chino, revived — Southern workwear as sportswear.
origin: Founded 1865 in Nashville, Tennessee; the name comes from the duck canvas it was cut from. Dormant for years and owned since 2016 by Oxford Industries.
opview: Presents itself as an American heritage house, 1865 and Southern, making the chino it has always made.

onething.n: verified — the direct descendant of the 1978 Big Gold Patch chino the house is remembered for

notes.cotton: 63 of 90 clothing styles are cotton-dominant, and the name is the duck canvas itself
notes.murica: Nashville 1865, and the range still reads Southern rather than national
notes.comfort: spandex in 27 of 90 styles, the highest proportion of the eight houses read together

cities: No own stores — wholesale and direct only
